_what: the third vertex of the valB synthetic closure triangle -- cmpd4", the aza-scan analogue of the Wurz linker ring. DERIVED (no crystal exists), by two independent routes that agree.
_provenance: derived from wurz-calib-frozen.json's calib_hi (RCSB 8G1Q, CCD YHB) by valb_triangle_legs.derive() inside docker.io/triskit23/ternary-fep -- the production mapper's own container. No SMILES in this file was typed by hand.
_topology: valb-closure-triangle-pregate-2026-07-25.md section 2d (aza-scan at the linker ring), which REPLACED the design's four named candidates because each made T3 a double mutation that rbfe_map.validate_map() forbids on a closing edge.

calib_lo2.name: Wurz_cmpd4_aza
calib_lo2.modeled_from: 8G1Q (cmpd1 crystal pose; no separate crystal exists)

derivation.transform: linker ring aza-scan: the free C-H most remote from both ring substituents becomes an aromatic N
derivation.route_A: frozen calib_lo (cmpd4) --(C->N at ring atom 29)--> cmpd4"
derivation.route_B: frozen calib_hi (cmpd1) --(N->C at ring atom 35, C->N at ring atom 34)--> cmpd4"
derivation.site_rule: the eligible free ring C-H with the greatest minimum ring-bond distance to any substituted ring atom; ties by RDKit canonical rank. Topological, so it is invariant to atom ordering and to a canonical-rank implementation change.

calib_lo2.heavy_dummy_basis: every edge is a pure aromatic ELEMENT change (N<->C), which maps 1:1 and creates no appearing/disappearing heavy atom. This is the property that keeps the softcore region -- the runbook's own root cause for this lane's warmup NaNs -- exactly the size it already is.
calib_lo2.note: DERIVED, not observed. The 5-part gate re-checks built-vs-frozen identity at leg time, and the endpoint pose is built from cmpd1's crystal coordinates by a two-atom aromatic element swap that preserves every coordinate.

T1.status: ALREADY RUN as valB_mini r0 (seed 0, 2 fs) -- reused, not re-bought

triangle.seed_requirement: ALL THREE EDGES AT SEED 0. Ternary seed s selects the s%n-th independently relaxed SMARCA2 model, so a mixed-seed triangle is computed on different Hamiltonians and |R| stops being a closure residual.
triangle.binary_legs: UNRESTRAINED, matching r0. Restraining them would make R measure the protocol difference rather than the path error, and would forfeit the r0-as-T1 reuse.
triangle.timestep_requirement: 2 fs production / 1 fs warmup, matching r0. The lane's 4 fs default is RUNG 2b's and must not reach this mode.
